_about: Public-domain Frederick Oakeley (1802-1880), Tractarian incumbent of Margaret Chapel and after 1845 a Catholic priest, for the Word Hoard: his writings on the subject of Tract XC (1841 and 1845), Remarks upon Aristotelian and Platonic Ethics, Laudes Diurnae, The Order and Ceremonial of the Mass, The Church of the Bible, Popular Lectures, Historical Notes on the Tractarian Movement, Catholic Worship, and early sermons and letters. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 137 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
